definitions.gloss: generally, on the whole, overall, all in all
definitions.explanation: Used to make a general statement about a group, situation, or trend, acknowledging that individual cases may differ. Indicates a broad summary or assessment.

examples.japanese: {総|そう}じて⟦{好評|こうひょう}→好評：16720_kouhyou⟧だった。
examples.english: On the whole, it was well received.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{総|そう}じて⟦{良好|りょうこう}→良好：13954_ryoukou⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}える→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: This year's results can be said to be generally good.

examples.japanese: ⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{総|そう}じて⟦{肯定的|こうていてき}→肯定的：06334_kouteiteki⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The participants' reactions were generally positive, though there were some voices of dissatisfaction.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat formal adverb used in written Japanese, reports, and evaluations. Implies that the speaker is summarizing a broad picture while acknowledging exceptions may exist.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全体的|ぜんたいてき}→全体的：11663_zentaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: overall, as a whole (more common in everyday speech)
- ⟦{概|おおむ}ね→概ね：05732_oomune⟧: generally, for the most part (similar formality level)
- ⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: generally, in general (makes a broader generalization)
- {大体|だいたい}: roughly, generally (more casual)

COMMON PATTERNS:
Placed at the beginning or middle of a sentence, before the main predicate it modifies. Often followed by evaluative expressions.
